title: American Time Use Survey 2023 public-use respondent and activity files

doi.absence_reason: BLS does not assign a DOI to the annual ATUS public-use files.

units.TUDIARYDAY: categorical day code, Sunday 1 through Saturday 7
units.diary_clock: local civil time, diary window 04:00 to 04:00

measurement_uncertainty.description: The result applies final survey weights but does not calculate replicate-weight sampling intervals or diary-reporting error.

known_gaps: ATUS represents the U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized population and is not an Italian-household measurement source.
BLS does not collect location for sleeping, grooming, and some personal activities; sleeping is explicitly inferred at home and other missing locations remain masked.
The current model does not condition schedules on household composition or demographic covariates.
The result validates schedule distributions, not causal responses of windows, HVAC, lights, or appliances to environmental conditions.

preprocessing.description: Verify both ZIP checksums, join respondent weights to complete activity diaries, rotate 04:00 diaries to a midnight clock, isolate respondents by stable hash, fit whole-diary probabilities on development records, and score the holdout.

permitted_use.purpose: Population-prior calibration and behavioral schedule validation research
permitted_use.notes: Retain BLS attribution and do not interpret weighted population priors as individual-household truth.
